verdict.rationale: Bruno's core design is collections stored as plain-text files/folders on the filesystem, organized via a GUI and rerunnable anytime via the app or the Bruno CLI, including in CI/CD pipelines and Docker; this is corroborated by community adoption switching from Postman for exactly this file-based collection model. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of folder-nesting/reordering UX specifically, and resolution of a reported settings-save bug that could affect reliability of edits within collections.
